Description.DefaultText: Hidden fuel pool for the village's communal wood pile, measured in the same units the vanilla Fireplace burns (1 per tick, 96 for a full hearth). Rises when fuel is stacked on the Town Wood Pile in the village, falls whenever one of the six village hearths is automatically topped off or re-lit. Starts at 96 - one full hearth's worth - so a run that has never seen the pile still gets a grace period before the village fires start going out. This is the canonical store: the pile's own Wood Stockpile bar is a display mirror of it, because the hearths that draw on it sit in interiors where the pile card is not on the board.
